dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Spyro was surrendered to the care center by his previous owner as they no longer had time to care for him. They describe him as a very affectionate dog who wants to be where his people are, and enjoys car rides and outdoor activities. Spyro has not acclimated well to the care center environment, and has allowed only minimal handing since intake. He has shown fearful behavior, stopping and refusing to walk when being returned to kennel, and has been tense and avoidant around handling, escalating to lip curl and growling on one occasion. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Spyro
